// Strict installed-tarball consumer of the frozen published 1.1.0 port types.
import { connect, type IssueEvent, type IssueTrackerWithLabels } from "@lutzseverino/postern";
import type * as Published from "./published-1.1.0.js";

const unused = (): never => { throw new Error("compile fixture only"); };

// A producer written against 1.1.0 supplies only the original comment fields.
const publishedEvent: Published.IssueEvent = {
  platform: "github", repository: "octo/hello", issue: 42,
  kind: "commentDeleted", actor: { login: "mona", bot: false },
  label: null, openingLabels: null, bodyChanged: null,
  comment: { id: 123, body: "Deleted body" },
};
const publishedTracker: Published.IssueTrackerWithLabels = {
  capabilities: {},
  issues: unused,
  issue: unused,
  issueEvent: async () => publishedEvent,
  labelChanges: unused,
  comments: unused,
  addLabels: unused,
  removeLabel: unused,
  createLabel: unused,
  labels: unused,
  updateLabel: unused,
  createComment: unused,
  updateComment: unused,
  closeIssue: unused,
};
export const compatibleEvent: IssueEvent = publishedEvent;
export const compatibleTracker: IssueTrackerWithLabels = publishedTracker;

// Normal connect() inference exposes the new, optional comment identifier.
const concrete = connect("https://github.com/octo/hello");
export const nodeId = async () => {
  const event = await concrete.issueTracker.issueEvent({ name: "issue_comment", payload: {} });
  return event?.comment?.nodeId;
};
type Equal<A, B> =
  (<T>() => T extends A ? 1 : 2) extends (<T>() => T extends B ? 1 : 2) ? true : false;
type Assert<T extends true> = T;
export type InferredNodeId = Assert<Equal<ReturnType<typeof nodeId>, Promise<string | null | undefined>>>;
